Sanju Samson discusses pressure and team goals

Cricketer Sanju Samson stated that he embraces pressure and supports a fearless approach, particularly following a win against Afghanistan. He emphasized that team objectives and securing victories are paramount, with selections based on a player's current form. Samson acknowledged external pressures but noted that experience helps in managing them. He also commented on being dropped from a team, comparing himself to a "15-year-old boy" in that context.
